note: Blocks for the browser's Peninsula materials (renderer/land/ground.js, spring grass, the default season in land.json; renderer/engine/look.js). Grass is the ground; soil only on the bank and in patches; rock only where the slope rule puts it. Approximate and illustrative.

biomeColours.note: The datapack redefines the world's biome with these colours. Grass and oak leaves take the tint; the grass texture darkens it, so the grass colour is brighter than the browser's spring ground (#659530 to #95b345 in sRGB). Spruce leaves (Douglas-fir) keep their fixed colour. Green-tinted water for land.json's 'green' optics; a pale marine-layer fog.

plants.note: Green grass and a few ferns on top of grass blocks.

trees.note: Species and weights follow land.json and biome.json (coast-live 0.9, douglas-fir 0.1, grouped in stands). Heights in metres; crowns use oakSite's radius. Douglas-fir is drawn as a cone.
